author: Cora / original Sugata artist blockout

frame.origin: ground-centre design datum; no body registration

surfaceContract: Every front/back outer endpoint is the same vertex. Upper rows loft through complete arcs. Each half of the final upper front/back arcs lofts to its corresponding complete leg mouth. One crotch diamond joins upper-front centre, left-leg inner endpoint, upper-back centre, right-leg inner endpoint. All lower leg rows loft completely. No independent intersecting tubes or inferred hidden fill.
triangulation: Each authored oriented quad [a,b,c,d] becomes [a,b,c] and [a,c,d], including crotch diamond. No triangulation search.

materials.waistband: neutral charcoal clay region, not stitched fabric
materials.body: neutral charcoal clay region, not wool/cloth simulation

limits: Original unitless artist geometry; no metric/body/foundation/boot correspondence, image measurement, physical pattern/drape, seam/pocket interiors, material finish, rig/morph/pose/motion/fit/AAA qualification. No full self-intersection or collision predicate. Hem is an open design interface; actual boot break is untested.
